All 69 test methods pass under `defects4j compile` and `JUnitCore`. Only the single file `gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/internal/$Gson$TypesAgentTest.java` was created, matching the project's existing JUnit 3 (`extends TestCase`) style used throughout `gson/src/test/java`.

Coverage includes: parameterized type construction (owner rules, static-vs-local class, null/primitive argument rejection, `toString`, `equals`/`hashCode`, defensive array cloning, `Serializable`), array types, `subtypeOf`/`supertypeOf` wildcard construction (including null rejection and nested-wildcard reuse), `canonicalize` for classes/arrays/parameterized/generic-array/wildcard/type-variable, `getRawType` across all branches including the `IllegalArgumentException` for unsupported input, the public `equals(Type, Type)` across every type kind and mismatched-kind cases, `typeToString`, `getArrayComponentType` (including its `ClassCastException` on non-array input), `getCollectionElementType`/`getMapKeyAndValueTypes` (parameterized, raw/`Object` fallback, and the `Properties` special case), and `resolve` (type-variable resolution, unresolvable method-declared variables, and generic-array component resolution).
